description: Follower trend for the show on Apple Podcasts over a date range: one value per period plus the change across the window. Use it for 'is my Apple following growing'. Read the resolvedColumn field in the response before interpreting the numbers: Apple's follower column has been both a running total and a per-period count, and which one you get changes what 'change' means.

end.description: End of the range, YYYY-MM-DD (or YYYY-MM for Monthly). Defaults to 2 days ago, because Apple publishes reports on a lag.

max_periods.description: How many periods to fetch, cap 31. Reporter has no range query, so each period is a separate call to Apple and a wide range will hit their throttle. Default 14. Ranges longer than this are truncated to the most recent periods.

period.description: Reporter period. Daily and Weekly take YYYY-MM-DD dates; Monthly takes YYYY-MM. Weekly dates are Apple's week-ending Sundays.

start.description: Start of the range, YYYY-MM-DD (or YYYY-MM for Monthly). Defaults to 7 days back for Daily, 7 weeks for Weekly, 6 months for Monthly — each sized to fit the default max_periods of 7.

name: apple_podcasts_followers
